title: Exome and Genome Analysis to Elucidate Genetic Etiologies and Population Characteristics in the Plain Community
official: Use of Whole Exome Sequencing/Whole Genome Sequencing in the Plain Communities
summary: This study is designed to utilize whole exome and whole genome sequencing techniques to identify underlying genetic causes for undiagnosed disorders in the Plain Communities, and to do population genetic studies looking at genetic drift and founder mutations in this unique population.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Any person of Amish or Mennonite descent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Individuals who are not of Amish or Mennonite descent
